facts.activity_series: maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment

integrity of the mechanical seal support system

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: thermal release during a planned shutdown on P-4103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control BUND_AND_DRAINAGE_CONTAINMENT: the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control HYDROCARBON_TRANSFER_CONTROL: the controlled transfer of hydrocarbon between vessels was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an organisational factor.
Control SEAL_FACE_TEMPERATURE_ALARM: the seal-face high-temperature alarm and trip was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control SEAL_SUPPORT_SYSTEM_INTEGRITY: the integrity of the mechanical seal support system had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the secondary containment by bund and drainage on P-4103 and TT-4103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
Restore the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on P-4103 and TT-4103 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining sealing systems on rotating equipment, specifically setting and proving mechanical seal support systems. P-4103 (hydrocarbon transfer pumps) is in service for hydrocarbon transfer, single mechanical seal with pressurised barrier-fluid support. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the secondary containment by bund and drainage had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 10 October 2025 an incident occurred on P-4103 and TT-4103 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during a planned shutdown, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
